@@ -532,0 +532,2 @@
+#ifndef _WINDOWS
+    // On Windows, r30 and r31 are nonvolatile per the x64 ABI.
@@ -534,0 +536,1 @@
+#endif

@@ -3630,0 +3630,4 @@
+#ifdef _WINDOWS
+    // On Windows, r30 and r31 are nonvolatile per the x64 ABI.
+    regs += RegSet::range(r16, r29);
+#else
@@ -3631,0 +3635,1 @@
+#endif

@@ -103,3 +103,4 @@
-    // EGPRs are call clobbered registers, Explicit clearing of r16 and r31 during signal
-    // handling guarantees that preserved register values post signal handling were
-    // re-instantiated by operating system and not because they were not modified externally.
+    // EGPRs are call clobbered registers. Explicit clearing of r16 and the last volatile EGPR
+    // (r31 for non-Windows and r29 for Windows) during signal handling guarantees that
+    // the preserved register values after signal handling were re-instantiated by the
+    // operating system and not because they were not modified externally.
@@ -112,0 +113,3 @@
+#ifdef _WINDOWS
+    __ mov64(r29, 0L);
+#else
@@ -113,0 +117,1 @@
+#endif
@@ -445,0 +450,3 @@
+#ifdef _WINDOWS
+    __ mov64(r29, VM_Version::egpr_test_value());
+#else
@@ -446,0 +454,1 @@
+#endif
@@ -454,0 +463,3 @@
+#ifdef _WINDOWS
+    __ movq(Address(rsi, 8), r29);
+#else
@@ -455,0 +467,1 @@
+#endif

@@ -681,1 +681,2 @@
-    jlong        apx_save[2]; // Save r16 and r31
+    jlong        apx_save[2]; // Save r16 and the last volatile EGPR
+                              // (r29 on Windows, r31 on non-Windows)

@@ -173,0 +173,11 @@
+#ifdef _WIN64
+
+// On Win64, R30 and R31 are nonvolatile (callee saved)
+reg_def R30  (SOC, SOE, Op_RegI, 30, r30->as_VMReg());
+reg_def R30_H(SOC, SOE, Op_RegI, 30, r30->as_VMReg()->next());
+
+reg_def R31  (SOC, SOE, Op_RegI, 31, r31->as_VMReg());
+reg_def R31_H(SOC, SOE, Op_RegI, 31, r31->as_VMReg()->next());
+
+#else
+
@@ -179,0 +190,2 @@
+#endif
+
